title: Pharmacy Technician Certificate
description: The certificate will equip the learners with the knowledge and practical skills required to work effectively as pharmacy technicians in diverse healthcare settings
longDescription: The course focuses on understanding pharmacology, applying safe medication practices, and demonstrating communication and customer service skills. Learners will also gain experience in prescription processing, dosage calculations, and assisting in patient education. By the end of this course, learners will be competent in handling pharmacy operations with accuracy and professionalism. The course will commence in the first week of November.
courseDetails: Explain the roles and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician. Understand the structure and operations of community and hospital pharmacies. Identify the importance of accuracy and safety in pharmacy practice. Apply professional and ethical standards in daily operations. Recognize career pathways and advancement opportunities in pharmacy. Demonstrate basic organizational and record-keeping skills. Explain the basic principles of pharmacology and drug actions. Identify major drug classifications and their therapeutic uses. Understand routes of administration and dosage forms. Apply knowledge of common medications to assist in dispensing. Recognize potential drug interactions and contraindications. Demonstrate safe handling and storage of medications. Interpret and process prescriptions accurately. Apply labeling and packaging standards in medication dispensing. Calculate dosages using standard formulas and conversions. Demonstrate skills in preparing compounded medications under supervision. Implement double-check systems to minimize errors. Communicate with pharmacists to clarify prescription details when needed. Understand the legal framework governing pharmacy practice. Apply ethical principles in all pharmacy-related activities. Recognize controlled substances and follow proper handling procedures. Demonstrate knowledge of confidentiality and patient privacy standards. Implement safety measures to prevent medication errors. Educate patients on proper medication usage under supervision. Demonstrate skills in managing pharmacy inventory effectively. Apply techniques for stock rotation and expiration date monitoring. Utilize pharmacy software for inventory and prescription tracking. Communicate professionally with patients and healthcare providers. Handle customer inquiries and provide accurate medication information. Manage workload efficiently in high-demand pharmacy settings The Pharmacy Technician Certificate program provides essential knowledge and practical skills for assisting pharmacists in dispensing medications, managing prescriptions, and ensuring patient safety. The course covers pharmaceutical calculations, drug classifications, inventory management, pharmacy law and ethics, dosage forms, and patient communication. Learners gain expertise in preparing medications, maintaining accurate records, and supporting pharmacists in both retail and hospital pharmacy settings. This program prepares graduates to work effectively in diverse healthcare environments while adhering to professional standards. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Unit 1: Introduction to Pharmacy Practice and Technician Roles Learning Outcomes: Unit 2: Pharmacology and Drug Classifications Unit 3: Prescription Processing and Medication Dispensing Unit 4: Pharmacy Laws, Ethics, and Patient Safety Unit 5: Inventory Management and Customer Service in Pharmacy

The Pharmacy Technician Certificate program provides essential knowledge and practical skills for assisting pharmacists in dispensing medications, managing prescriptions, and ensuring patient safety. The course covers pharmaceutical calculations, drug classifications, inventory management, pharmacy law and ethics, dosage forms, and patient communication. Learners gain expertise in preparing medications, maintaining accurate records, and supporting pharmacists in both retail and hospital pharmacy settings. This program prepares graduates to work effectively in diverse healthcare environments while adhering to professional standards.
After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to:
Unit 1: Introduction to Pharmacy Practice and Technician Roles
Learning Outcomes:
Unit 2: Pharmacology and Drug Classifications
Unit 3: Prescription Processing and Medication Dispensing
Unit 4: Pharmacy Laws, Ethics, and Patient Safety
Unit 5: Inventory Management and Customer Service in Pharmacy
entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be an added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
The certificate is designed to enhance the learner's knowledge in the field. This certificate is for everyone eager to know more and get updated on current ideas in their respective field.

modules.title: Pharmacy Technician Certificate
modules.summary: The Pharmacy Technician Certificate equips learners with the knowledge and skills to support pharmacists in dispensing medications and providing patient care. The course covers pharmacology basics, drug preparation, dosage calculations, and pharmacy law and ethics. Students learn inventory control, prescription processing, and medication safety practices. Emphasis is placed on accuracy, attention to detail, and adherence to regulatory standards. Practical training ensures competence in both community and hospital pharmacy settings. Graduates are prepared for entry-level roles as certified pharmacy technicians.
